content: {"episode_id":"ep-05050","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal concerns the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05050. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, and the claim was submitted with diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1. Given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events. We request reconsideration on medical necessity grounds based on this documentation."}
